description: KOMODO, published by imronuke, solves static and transient multigroup neutron diffusion for reactor-core problems. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: GPU support through OpenACC is described as partial. Teaching suitability and numerical method descriptions do not constitute validation for reactor design decisions. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance.
